video_title: Inside ClickDo’s Lifestyle Brand Collaboration: How I Supported Fernando Raymond’s Creator Campaign with Mother Root
evidence: A July 22, 2026 English-language campaign write-up documents Mother Root approaching ClickDo CEO and creator Fernando Raymond for a social-first partnership showing the drink in authentic remote-working routines; ClickDo's public LinkedIn partnership announcement says the campaign drove 40K+ views in its first week. Mother Root currently operates an official community/creator partnership program offering affiliate marketing, gifting, discount codes, content creation and campaigns. Catherine Sarsfield is currently identified as Mother Root's Head of Brand, and current public Mother Root campaign posts credit her with leading brand creative direction and production.
